intended_fixture_judgment: The intended-regulatory-behavior check is empty and unavailable, not a pass. No concrete inputs, expected regulated outputs or boundaries demonstrate avoidance of negative amortization or exclusion of unpaid charges from interest capitalization. Penalty reachability alone cannot serve as the regulatory oracle.

The procedure-division-preserved source assertion does not verify output or downstream behavior. Cycle-day boundaries, flag Y/N and other accepted values, delay zero and upper representable values, and chain handoff are untested.

Compiler availability does not prove these cases compile, execute or satisfy the clause. Finite fixtures cannot establish complete semantic equivalence; the stated static limitations further restrict proof. No complete interprogram value-flow or chain orchestration evidence is supplied.
duplicate_source_judgment: Preselection before detector results and explicit treatment of repeated bundles as dependent groups provide a defensible selection rationale, conditional on preserving disclosure and avoiding independent-case interval claims. They do not supply missing regulatory or fixture evidence. This exclusion does not approve retention under the all-reviewers-approve condition.
